results.text: Targeting the NRF2 pathway with linagliptin to inhibit human hepatocellular carcinoma growth. Linagliptin, a potent dipeptidyl peptidase 4 (DPP4) inhibitor, demonstrates significant potential as a therapeutic agent for hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC). This study evaluated the effects of linagliptin on HCC cell lines, focusing on mechanisms involving reactive oxygen species (ROS) production, nuclear factor erythroid 2-related factor 2 (NRF2) pathway activation, and autophagy.
